notes.title: Rebirth Reborn: Wanderlust Adventures
notes.notes:
If you have ever played and enjoyed Secret Of Mana, you may already be aware of Wanderlust: Rebirth, a top-down action RPG with combat and graphics reminiscent of Square’s real-time battler. Wanderlust Adventures is a sequel/spin-off to Rebirth, expanding into a free-roaming open world, as the ‘Wanderlust’ of the title always suggested. The freedom of exploration aside, the big draw for Adventures is stronger online implementation. The game can be played with three chums cooperatively, or with up to eight players in competitive modes. Connections will be handled through Steam’s network API rather than, allowing for ‘seamless’ shenanigans.

… [visit site to read more]

notes.title: Wanderlust: Rebirth Patch Notes - 3.08 & 3.09 [Steam]
notes.notes:
We implemented a new matchmaking system which should allow players to now host without port-forwarding. The downside? No private games (at least not until we figure out a way to do them), until then, it should be much much easier to play online with other players.

[b]PATCH 3.08[/b]
[list]
    [*] All new matchmaking system
    [*] Steam Networking API integration (no more port-forwarding req.)
[/list]

[EDIT]:
[b]PATCH 3.09[/b]
[list]
    [*] Added private lobby functionality
    [*] Fixed a bug with joining PvP games
    [*] Fixed a bug with Ice Wall
[/list]

Enjoy!
-Yeti Trunk

notes.title: Wanderlust: Rebirth Patch Notes - 3.06
notes.notes:
[h1]PATCH 3.06[/h1][list][*] Added a multipurpose Announcement Window at the start of the game.
[*] Added pre-chapter Tips Screen for Normal Mode : to help players improve their chapter scores.
[*] Added a short-term immunity (to statuses) after they affect your character.
[*] The Chapter 5 Boss can now be damaged slightly while armored (instead of invulnerable).
[*] Updated some maps and upgraded the cavern tileset (seen below).
[*] Added foreground (roof tiles) to indoor maps (seen below).
[/list]

Wanderlust: Rebirth is Now Available on Steam and 25% off until Friday, August 3rd 10AM PDT.

Take control of one of four uniquely crafted character classes, each with a distinctive play style, and use your abilities with finesse along side the other heroes to gain high-scores and legendary items. Band together and plan your assault, for the minions of the underworld fear no blade, and only in Epic mode will the true heroines rise victorious.
